candidates.reason: Direct feature-name overlap (skill system). The in-tree crates/pheno-agent/phenotype-skills is currently a stub; a published phenotype-skills crate would replace it.

candidates.name: phenotype-event-bus
candidates.reason: Domain event bus (AgentStarted, AgentCompleted, ToolCalled) is hand-rolled in src/domain/events; phenotype-event-bus is the current shared target for lifecycle/event streaming contracts.

candidates.name: phenotype-registry
candidates.reason: SkillRegistry and ToolRegistry are bespoke; a shared registry crate with content-addressed registration would replace both.

candidates.reason: Supply-chain and dependency-pinning governance; pair with the existing deny.toml + cargo-deny.yml workflow.

candidates.name: phenotype-request-id
candidates.reason: session_id is plumbed through Context; a shared request-id crate would unify correlation IDs across agent calls, tool calls, and event emissions.

candidates.name: phenoShared
candidates.reason: Shared error + result types; the bespoke Error enum in src/domain/errors could be a re-export of the phenoShared type.

candidates.name: phenoUtils
candidates.reason: Builder / config helpers; the AgentConfig builder in src/domain/agents could be backed by phenoUtils::Configurable.

candidates.name: phenotype-tooling
candidates.reason: Tool/CLI helpers; the [[bin]] agentkit CLI under src/bin/ would benefit from standardized arg parsing and config loading.

candidates.name: phenotype-journeys

candidates.name: phenotype-hub

candidates.name: phenotype-infra

candidates.name: phenotype-voxel
candidates.reason: Visualization substrate for agent traces / execution graphs; optional visualization layer.

sota_gaps.description: Features present in the broader Phenotype SOTA stack that are missing or weak here.

items.evidence: No central tokens or single-source config surface; CHANGELOG / README / Cargo.toml all repeat versions manually.
docs/PATH_TO_SIDEKICK.md admits <1% coverage (3 tests). No coverage workflow in .github/workflows/. STANDARDS.md cites tarpaulin 80% gate but the gate is unenforced.
Domain Output/Context/MemoryEntry types are not covered by snapshot tests; only proptest + mockall in dev-dependencies.
.pre-commit-config.yaml only runs pre-commit-hooks (trailing-ws, eof-fixer, check-yaml, check-merge-conflict). No yamllint step. No .yamllint config.
Only tracing + tracing-subscriber are present. No opentelemetry / opentelemetry-otlp deps. No OTEL collector wiring.

Root Cargo.toml declares [workspace] but omits `members`; CI `cargo build --workspace --verbose` therefore only builds agentkit. The 7 sub-crates (phenotype-daemon, phenotype-skills, pheno-proc-*) are invisible to CI gates.
docs/PATH_TO_SIDEKICK.md marks 'Feature Registry' as Planned. No FUNCTIONAL_REQUIREMENTS.md at repo root (one exists only under crates/pheno-agent/).

items.gap: API contract tests / JSON schema validation
items.evidence: API_CONTRACT_AUDIT.md exists but no schemars / jsonschema dep; no contract-test job in CI.
src/adapters/llm/mod.rs is a placeholder; openai feature flag exists but no reqwest call site yet.
src/adapters/memory/mod.rs is a placeholder; feature flags exist (redis-memory, sqlite-memory) but adapter code is empty.
No [[bench]] sections; no criterion dev-dep. PATH_TO_SIDEKICK.md mentions criterion as future work.
Not in dev-deps, no CI job. Some imported types in src/domain are likely unused (e.g. MemoryPort/ToolExecutor if not invoked).
cargo-deny.yml covers advisories via `cargo deny check advisories`, but no standalone cargo-audit workflow; deny advisory-db is path-dependent on $CARGO_HOME.

items.gap: Miri / unsafe sanity (irrelevant here since unsafe_code = 'forbid', but no formal marker in CI)
items.evidence: unsafe_code forbidden in [lints.rust], so Miri is low-value; mention only for completeness.

items.gap: License / version consistency in sub-crate Cargo.toml files
items.evidence: pheno-proc-uds/Cargo.toml omits `license`; pheno-proc-dedup omits `authors`; root agentkit has license but not all sub-crates spell it the same way. cargo-deny would flag this.
PATH_TO_SIDEKICK.md target is 2+ adopter repos (agileplus-agents, thegent-dispatch). No Cargo.toml in those repos currently depends on agentkit (verified by absence in sibling tree).

convergence_cluster.label: other
convergence_cluster.rationale: Pure single-stack Rust framework (agentkit) with two nested Rust sub-crate groups (pheno-agent, pheno-proc-runtime). No web frontend, no TypeScript, no Python bindings in active source. Not a web-stack (no React/Next/etc.), not multi-stack. Falls in 'other' as a single-language Rust framework cluster.

action_items.title: Wire the 7 sub-crates into the root [workspace] members
action_items.impact: CI's `cargo build --workspace` and `cargo test --workspace` are currently scoped to agentkit only; the pheno-proc-* and pheno-agent sub-crates are invisible to gates. Adding `members = ["crates/*/...", "crates/*/*"]` to root Cargo.toml is a 5-line change that fixes the gap.

action_items.title: Add coverage workflow (cargo-llvm-cov + Codecov)
action_items.impact: PATH_TO_SIDEKICK.md self-reports <1% coverage. STANDARDS.md demands 80%. Add a `.github/workflows/coverage.yml` running `cargo llvm-cov --workspace --lcov --output-path lcov.info` and upload to Codecov. Without this, the Sidekick promotion criteria cannot be met.

action_items.title: Adopt OpenTelemetry for agent/tool/memory spans
action_items.impact: Today the agent lifecycle is observable only via tracing macros with no exporter. Adding opentelemetry + opentelemetry-otlp + a tracing-opentelemetry layer gives the ExecutionStep / AgentStarted events a first-class span model and unifies with the rest of the Phenotype stack.

action_items.title: Replace the 7 sub-crate stubs with shared pheno-* libraries
action_items.impact: crates/pheno-agent/phenotype-skills duplicates ../phenotype-skills; the bespoke SkillRegistry/ToolRegistry/EventBus in src/domain/ are good candidates to back onto phenotype-event-bus + phenotype-registry. Each substitution shrinks the local surface and reduces drift risk across the org.

action_items.title: Author FUNCTIONAL_REQUIREMENTS.md at repo root with FR-AGK-* IDs
action_items.impact: Sidekick qualification requires a feature registry. Lift the existing crates/pheno-agent/FUNCTIONAL_REQUIREMENTS.md to the repo root, expand it to cover all 8 crates, and link each FR to a test file.

task_brief_alignment: Confirmed: 8 crates total (1 root + 7 sub-crates in 2 nested groups). The task brief's '12 plugin-trait crates' overstates the count.

Confirmed: NO inventory::submit! or ctor::ctor macro usage anywhere. Plugin traits are registered manually through Box<dyn Trait> registries. The task brief's 'inventory+ctor' wording is not accurate for this repo.
Confirmed: hygiene_score 100/100; all 10 rubric items are present.
Confirmed: convergence_cluster 'other' (single Rust stack, not web-stack or multi-stack).
